scope: Isolated loopback fixture; real Java protocol clients and desktop/mobile Chromium. No physical Bedrock GUI acceptance.

checks.check: Both candidate plugins load on the real 26.2 server
AuthMe prevents administrative writes before login
Every test actor is authenticated and non-OP
Only the designated test administrator receives the new administrative permission
Ordinary users cannot create clans, including legacy create permission and aliases
An administrator creates a clan for another authenticated leader
An administrator assigns an arbitrary RGB color in the native clan record
Another real client receives the exact chosen RGB color in the clan chat prefix
Ordinary users and invalid RGB input cannot change the clan color
Ordinary leader invitations and clan group permissions still work
Revoking administration during a creation conversation prevents its final write
The native clan create command works for a non-OP administrator
An administrator already in a clan can create a separate clan for another leader
Native left click adds a wand vertex without breaking the selected block
Native right click undoes the last wand vertex
A non-admin holding a copied wand gets no editing ability or special block protection
An administrator saves a six-vertex concave territory
BlueMap exposes clan territories as a separate toggleable layer
The map receives the same concave polygon with the exact clan RGB and transparent fill
A permanent name marker is placed over the filled territory
Ordinary players cannot create, delete or reassign territories
A real client receives the clan name in the actionbar on entry
The concave notch is outside and triggers a real exit actionbar
Territory detection applies at high altitude without a Y restriction
A player really breaks a block inside another clan territory
A player really places a block inside the territory
Territory labels do not restrict opening a real chest
Adjacent clans may have a shared edge
Overlapping interiors are refused without changing existing territories
Crossing directly into a neighboring clan shows its own name
The existing creative claim system still creates claims
Clan labels do not bypass an existing creative claim
Existing creative clan trust still grants native block placement
Changing a territory label does not change GriefPrevention permissions
Territories from an unmapped creative dimension do not leak onto the survival map
Existing territories display the current clan name
The clan disbands through its normal leader flow
Recreating a clan with the same tag does not inherit old territories
A disbanded clan territory is also removed from BlueMap until explicitly reassigned
An administrator can explicitly reassign an old territory
Explicit reassignment updates the map color and permanent name together
Polygons, clan binding and delegated admin permission persist after restart
Custom clan RGB remains identical in the native record and map after restart
A real entry actionbar works after server restart
Creation remains admin-only after restart
An administrator can replace an existing boundary with a different polygon
An administrator can delete a territory without deleting the clan
No plugin/event errors occurred in the accepted scenario
